stage0027_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoaaa!
　I love you, $$シェリル$$!」

stage0027_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Man, I can't take it!
　That $$シェリル・ノーム$$ babe!」

stage0027_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「You're behind, $$トウジ$$!
　The moment I got to this world,
　I downloaded $$シェリル$$'s whole album!」

stage0027_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「But it's lovely, isn't it.
　Don't you think so too, Ikari?」

stage0027_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What did you think, Ayanami?
　That $$シェリル$$ person's song...」

stage0027_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（But somehow... my body feels strangely warm...）

stage0027_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Thank you, everyone!
　And to the people of $$アクエリア市$$,
　welcome to this world!」

stage0027_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ランカ$$
「To everyone living in this world now,
　let's all do our best together!」

stage0027_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミコット$$
「You're getting too excited, $$タクヤ$$」

stage0027_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But I think it's a lovely song too」

stage0027_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$オードリー$$
（I never imagined, back in the Asteroid Belt,
　the world's full of warm color, sound, scent...）

stage0027_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Guess you're still a fan of both, Mr. $$木下$$」

stage0027_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$木下$$
「Yep! They're both the best,
　so there's no need to pick just one!」

stage0027_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$n
「$$アルト$$... I'm going to have to
　rethink our friendship from now on」

stage0027_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even you believe some third-rate tabloid!?」

stage0027_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$n
「I only believe what I've seen with my own eyes」

stage0027_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, no excuses then, $$アルト$$,
　not after being shown $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$
　right in front of your eyes」

stage0027_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$宗介$$
「This world has plenty of cultures
　that permit polygamy」

stage0027_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ジン$$!
　Why the hell are you here too!」

stage0027_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ジン$$
「I didn't want to come either.
　But I got ordered to drag back
　someone who launched without permission」

stage0027_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Tch!
　So this is that old man $$イズモ$$'s doing!」

stage0027_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ジン$$
「The higher-ups have decided this planet
　is on par with Vega, and mean to continue the operation」

stage0027_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That works for me.
　Suits me just fine」

stage0027_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ジン$$
「Then hurry up and bring the $$ミスラ・グニス$$.
　Help with the mission and $$イズモ$$ won't complain」

stage0027_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Listen up, all of you!
　We launched Aquarion with
　the same members as last time!」

stage0027_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But depending on the situation,
　we'll swap Elements via Teleport Change!」

stage0027_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（The one who attacked $$ミコノ$$...
　is he coming out too...）

stage0027_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Are you even listening, $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

stage0027_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Come on, buddy!
　We can't look uncool in front of
　everyone at the ceremony!」

stage0027_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah...
　I don't hate that positive attitude of yours」

stage0027_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スオミ$$
「The military from this world has come too!」

stage0027_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$レイアム$$
「We've recovered the members
　who went to observe the ceremony」

stage0027_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$オットー$$
「Launch everyone as soon as they're ready!
　We must show that Aquarion thing
　just what our power is made of!」

stage0027_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$アマタ$$, was it...
　Let's do this again today」

stage0027_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Quit running your mouths!
　He's coming out!」

stage0027_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Those guys from before are here too!
　This oughta be fun!」

stage0027_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「But first,
　I'll crush the mech-angel that scentless bastard rides!」

stage0027_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Here I come, scentless bastard!
　I'll kill you and take that damn woman for myself!」

stage0027_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
???
「Forbidden love tastes of honey...
　but sweet honey draws the ants」

stage0027_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$不動$$
「And so, those fated to meet, meet.
　Yes... this is not love.
　This is a forbidden encounter...!」

stage0027_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シェリル$$
「$$ランカ$$...!
　What we can do at a time like this is...」

stage0027_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I know, $$シェリル$$!
　Let's sing!」

stage0027_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カツ$$
「It's the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$'s Lion!!」

stage0027_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シン$$
「Are you here to back us up!」

stage0027_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Alright!
　Let's do this, $$シェリル$$!」

stage0027_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Can't ask for more as a man, $$アルト$$」

stage0027_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シェリル$$
（Can you hear it, $$アルト$$...
　our song...）

stage0027_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ランカ$$
（It's reaching you, $$アルト$$...
　our feelings...）

stage0027_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ジン$$
「Wh, what is this...!
　This shock, not since I first heard $$アリシア$$'s song...!」

stage0027_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジン$$
「Says the guy who's just as shaken, $$カグラ$$!」

stage0027_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I, I don't get it!
　Something inside me keeps getting hotter and hotter!!」

stage0027_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジン$$
「Ah, aaah...!
　Even the dimensional boundary is warping!」

stage0027_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シェリル$$
（Could it be... our song crossed the dimensional wall...）

stage0027_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ランカ$$
（Did it call the Vajra here...?）

stage0027_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$リディ$$
「What the hell are those bugs!?」

stage0027_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Those are creatures called Vajra.
　They're able to communicate
　using Fold Waves as a medium」

stage0027_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$宗介$$
「That they'd show up in this situation too...!」

stage0027_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「No need to worry, $$宗介$$.
　The Vajra aren't our enemy」

stage0027_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$マオ$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0027_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$'s songs
　carry Fold Waves within them」

stage0027_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アルト$$
「Because of that, the Vajra understood us,
　and realized we're not their enemy」

stage0027_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So that's the truth behind how the fight against
　the Vajra ended in the $$再世戦争$$」

stage0027_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アルト$$
「So then, there's no need to fight the Vajra...」

stage0027_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Everyone, stop!
　Don't you understand who we are!?」

stage0027_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Run, $$ランカ$$!
　These things won't listen to your song!」

stage0027_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「What will you do, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

stage0027_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...We have no choice but to fight back」

stage0027_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Face reality.
　Hesitation will put many lives at risk」

stage0027_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Wait, please!
　The dimensional boundary's warp continues!」

stage0027_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$クラン$$
「Is a spacequake about to hit!?」

stage0027_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, brace for impact!」

stage0027_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$桂$$
「Wh-whoa...!
　I thought we got caught in a spacequake,
　and now there's a ton of familiar faces!」

stage0027_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$モーム$$
「I can't detect the Groma or Master $$オルソン#50$$!」

stage0027_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$桂$$
「So then, we're the only ones who got swept away!?」

stage0027_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$不動$$
「It seems this world...
　is fated to become the edge of myth...」

stage0027_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$甲児$$
「That machine...I feel like I've seen it before...!」

stage0027_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$葵$$
「An $$オーガス$$!
　It's $$桂$$'s $$オーガス$$!」

stage0027_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$シン$$
「That's right, it's an $$オーガス$$!!」

stage0027_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
Kei
「What's with you all.
　Don't tell me you forgot this century's
　handsome boy, the great $$桂木桂$$?」

stage0027_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「That machine...did the spacequake bring it here?」

stage0027_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$桂$$
「It's been a while, Apollo!
　Aquarion's changed shape a little...」

stage0027_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$モーム$$
「More importantly, what was that?
　That Apollo, and Aquarion...」

stage0027_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$桂$$
「I wonder...?
　Did I really say something like that?」

stage0027_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$桂$$
「Maybe that headache scrambled my head...
　I've never even heard those words,
　Apollo or Aqueri, before...」

stage0027_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't go off on your own, amateur!」

stage0027_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But that guy looks like he's in bad shape!」

stage0027_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, kid...
　Not exactly cool, but I'll lean on you today」

stage0027_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
Kei
「I owe you one.
　I'm $$桂木桂$$. Nice to meet you」

stage0027_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（Hmm...so $$アマタ$$'s the kind type...）

stage0027_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ジン$$
「Watch yourself, $$カグラ$$.
　Those bugs seem set on attacking
　both us and the Vega side」

stage0027_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So basically, everyone here's an enemy!?
　Ain't that interesting!」

stage0027_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$エルモ$$
「$$ランカ$$, $$シェリル$$!
　Now, hurry and evacuate!」

stage0027_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Why...?
　Why do we have to fight the Vajra again...」

stage0027_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$n
「This isn't the time to hesitate, $$アルト$$」

stage0027_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アルト$$
「I know!
　What we have to do
　is protect the people here!」

stage0027_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$オットー$$
「But what's going on...
　I heard the boundary had stabilized,
　yet there's spacequakes, and now Vajra...」

stage0027_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$レイアム$$
「This world still seems far from stable」

stage0027_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it...my headaches just keep growing」

stage0027_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$...how do you read this?」

stage0027_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$不動$$
「Let's see...
　I'd say it's something like a donut」

stage0027_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$不動$$
「The time is drawing near.
　When it comes, the closed ring breaks,
　and all will return to the void...」

stage0027_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ドナール$$
「I don't understand a thing...!」

stage0027_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No good!
　That monster can still move!!」

stage0027_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You slowpoke!
　There's no way you can catch me!」

stage0027_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$スオミ$$
「I-Indeed, with Aquarion like this now,
　if kept at range, we can't fight back!」

stage0027_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But we've no way to counter that speed!」

stage0027_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ゼシカ・ウォン$$, force-eject!
　Change to $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!」

stage0027_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Who the hell are you!」

stage0027_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Wait, please, I...!
　I can't pilot that thing!」

stage0027_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Don't screw with me, old man!
　I take no orders from an outsider!
　Dressed like a clown at your age!」

stage0027_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$不動$$
「I had a bit of business to attend to...」

stage0027_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...pilot Aquarion」

stage0027_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's impossible!
　There's no way I can...!
　Element abilities aren't for me...」

stage0027_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$不動$$
「He's a clumsy man...
　He knows only one way to protect
　what matters: hurting himself」

stage0027_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（That's right...$$カイエン$$...
　my brother was always like that...）

stage0027_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（And I've always been protected.
　While $$カイエン$$ and $$アマタ$$ got hurt instead...）

stage0027_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$不動$$
「Can you do it?
　You, the girl who supposedly can't?」

stage0027_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's true I can't do anything.
　But...but...!
　I want to hold hands again!」

stage0027_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$, why are you here!?」

stage0027_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「You... I never wanted you on a battlefield...!」

stage0027_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The Despair Foresight I've seen again and again
　since childhood was telling me...!」

stage0027_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Foresight... that Bride in Mourning from before...」

stage0027_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$... if you got close to Aquarion,
　your life wouldn't be safe...!」

stage0027_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I wanted to protect you...!
　Even if you hated me for it...! You!」

stage0027_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What would some stranger who just showed up
　know about anything!?」

stage0027_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$桂$$
「To you, her big brother,
　she might always be a little sister,
　but to me, she's a proper cutie.」

stage0027_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$桂$$
「That kid sister's knight isn't you anymore.
　It's the nice guy she picks for herself.」

stage0027_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But the one who protected me
　until today was you, big brother.」

stage0027_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you...
　But I don't want to just be protected anymore.
　I want to protect $$カイエン$$, too, my brother.」

stage0027_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I want to get hurt for real, too.」

stage0027_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I'll fight alongside $$アマタ$$.」

stage0027_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Why is that...
　When $$ミコノ$$'s with me, I... somehow...!）

stage0027_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I feel like I can do anything!」

stage0027_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Aquarion and the Elements' Empathy Gauges
　are rising right before our eyes!」

stage0027_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This is Aquarion's heart, racing!」

stage0027_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$不動$$
「Aquarion's racing heart...
　That's the heartbeat of youth...」

stage0027_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「What is this, I'm so excited...!
　Like my heart's about to burst out!」

stage0027_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This racing heart...!
　Hand in hand, heart to heart...!
　A pounding heartbeat!」

stage0027_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ドナール$$
「It stretched!
　All the way over there, too!」

stage0027_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$不動$$
「The legendary Mugen Attack has been reborn!」

stage0027_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$クレア$$
「Another seal has been broken, $$不動$$...」

stage0027_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ジン$$
「Who knew there was such an outrageous move...
　Thanks to $$カグラ$$, I got some great data.」

stage0027_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ジン$$
「But now that I've got the data,
　it won't work on me anymore, mechanical angel.」

stage0027_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$宗介$$
「What in the world is that...?
　Too unreliable to be a weapon...!」

stage0027_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$カレン$$
「At times like this, just be glad and enjoy it.」

stage0027_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Thank you, $$ミコノ$$!
　It's thanks to you lending us your strength!」

stage0027_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm glad... I could help you two...」

stage0027_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Not good!
　$$ミコノ$$'s Aura Level is dropping!」

stage0027_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$スオミ$$
「I knew it, she still can't fight...!」

stage0027_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll go!
　After seeing something like that
　right in front of me, I can't stay quiet!」

stage0027_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　In place of $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0027_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$!
　Don't let $$ミコノ$$'s effort go to waste!」

stage0027_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「All right...!
　Our target's that yellow one over there!」

stage0027_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No good!
　He can still move!」

stage0027_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ジン$$
「Think that's enough to beat me? You're dead wrong.」

stage0027_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ジン$$
「Then, shall I change my approach...」

stage0027_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ジン$$
「I've already sized up the mechanical angel's range.
　From there, you have no weapon that can hit me.」

stage0027_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$スオミ$$
「It's no good!
　If Aquarion gets kept at a distance now,
　it has no way to fight!」

stage0027_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But if we force our way in close,
　we'll just make an easy target!」

stage0027_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ゼシカ・ウォン$$, force-eject!
　Change to $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!」

stage0027_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Who the hell are you!」

stage0027_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Wait, please, I...!
　I can't pilot that thing!」

stage0027_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Don't screw with me, old man!
　I take no orders from an outsider!
　Dressed like a clown at your age!」

stage0027_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$不動$$
「I had a bit of business to attend to...」

stage0027_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$不動$$
「$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...pilot Aquarion」

stage0027_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's impossible!
　There's no way I can...!
　Element abilities aren't for me...」

stage0027_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$不動$$
「He's a clumsy man...
　He knows only one way to protect
　what matters: hurting himself」

stage0027_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（That's right...$$カイエン$$...
　my brother was always like that...）

stage0027_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（And I've always been protected.
　While $$カイエン$$ and $$アマタ$$ got hurt instead...）

stage0027_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$不動$$
「Can you do it?
　You, the girl who supposedly can't?」

stage0027_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's true I can't do anything.
　But...but...!
　I want to hold hands again!」

stage0027_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$, why are you here!?」

stage0027_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「You... I never wanted you on a battlefield...!」

stage0027_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The Despair Foresight I've seen again and again
　since childhood was telling me...!」

stage0027_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Foresight... that Bride in Mourning from before...」

stage0027_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$ミコノ$$... if you got close to Aquarion,
　your life wouldn't be safe...!」

stage0027_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I wanted to protect you...!
　Even if you hated me for it...! You!」

stage0027_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What would some stranger who just showed up
　know about anything!?」

stage0027_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$桂$$
「To you, her big brother,
　she might always be a little sister,
　but to me, she's a proper cutie.」

stage0027_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$桂$$
「That kid sister's knight isn't you anymore.
　It's the nice guy she picks for herself.」

stage0027_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「But the one who protected me
　until today was you, big brother.」

stage0027_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you...
　But I don't want to just be protected anymore.
　I want to protect $$カイエン$$, too, my brother.」

stage0027_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I want to get hurt for real, too.」

stage0027_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I'll fight alongside $$アマタ$$.」

stage0027_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Why is that...
　When $$ミコノ$$'s with me, I... somehow...!）

stage0027_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I feel like I can do anything!」

stage0027_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Aquarion and the Elements' Empathy Gauges
　are rising right before our eyes!」

stage0027_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This is Aquarion's heart, racing!」

stage0027_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$不動$$
「Aquarion's racing heart...
　That's the heartbeat of youth...」

stage0027_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「What is this, I'm so excited...!
　Like my heart's about to burst out!」

stage0027_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This racing heart...!
　Hand in hand, heart to heart...!
　A pounding heartbeat!」

stage0027_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ジン$$
「Who knew they had a move this wild...
　But with this much data gathered,
　even $$イズモ$$ won't complain...」

stage0027_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$カグラ$$, I'll leave the rest to you」

stage0027_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ドナール$$
「It stretched!
　All the way over there, too!」

stage0027_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$不動$$
「The legendary Mugen Attack has been reborn!」

stage0027_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$クレア$$
「Another seal has been broken, $$不動$$...」

stage0027_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Not bad at all!
　Beating that $$ジン$$, are you!」

stage0027_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「But don't think that trick works on me too!」

stage0027_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$宗介$$
「What in the world is that...?
　Too unreliable to be a weapon...!」

stage0027_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$カレン$$
「At times like this, just be glad and enjoy it.」

stage0027_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Thank you, $$ミコノ$$!
　It's thanks to you lending us your strength!」

stage0027_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm glad... I could help you two...」

stage0027_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Not good!
　$$ミコノ$$'s Aura Level is dropping!」

stage0027_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$スオミ$$
「I knew it, she still can't fight...!」

stage0027_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll go!
　After seeing something like that
　right in front of me, I can't stay quiet!」

stage0027_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　In place of $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0027_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$!
　Don't let $$ミコノ$$'s effort go to waste!」

stage0027_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Alright...!
　Our target is that beast!」

stage0027_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't mess with me!
　You think this is enough to beat me!?」

stage0027_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Still a monster as ever, huh!」

stage0027_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$カイエン$$
「But if we keep fighting like this,
　we'll be at a disadvantage!」

stage0027_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$スオミ$$
「What will you do, Supreme Commander?」

stage0027_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$クレア$$
「You mustn't, $$シュレード$$!
　Your body can't endure
　piloting Aquarion!」

stage0027_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Thank you for your concern, Chairwoman $$クレア$$」

stage0027_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$シュレード$$
「But I don't mind if I die.
　If I can't play Aquarion,
　then I'm living while already dead...!」

stage0027_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$シュレード$$!
　If you're that resolved, swap with me!」

stage0027_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$クレア$$
「I grant permission to combine!
　$$シュレード・エラン$$!
　Give Aquarion a new form, with your power!」

stage0027_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　In place of $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$,
　$$シュレード・エラン$$!」

stage0027_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Say nothing, best friend...
　Let's play Aquarion together, now!」

stage0027_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$不動$$
「$$カイエン・スズシロ$$!

stage0027_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Let's go, $$アマタ$$, $$シュレード$$!
　I've got the Head!!」

stage0027_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$不動$$
「$$カイエン・スズシロ$$,

$$カイエン$$
「$$アクエリオンゲパルト$$!」

stage0027_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Like I'd let you escape!」

stage0027_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$シュレード$$
「It's finally here...

stage0027_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What a fierce sound! This is $$シュレード$$'s music!」

stage0027_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:

「This is life's sound! An innocent babe's first cry!」

stage0027_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:

「Aquarion has gained three forms!」

stage0027_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$不動$$
「Through $$シュレード$$'s power,
　a new form of strength was born...!」

$$シュレード$$

stage0027_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That's right, it's... the melody of the soul!」

stage0027_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You Mechanical Angel!

stage0027_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:

　Swap with $$ゼシカ$$ for a bit」

stage0027_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:

$$アマタ$$
「I can't leave that guy alone either!」

stage0027_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Here we go, arpeggio of the soul!」

stage0027_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:

「So those guys turned three hearts into one, huh」

stage0027_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:

$$アマタ$$

stage0027_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:

stage0027_04:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$ said she felt something

stage0027_04:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I don't know why, but I feel

stage0027_04:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So I can't afford to lose, not to you!」

stage0027_04:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So this is the enemy commander!」

stage0027_04:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$ジン$$
（I'm not like $$カグラ$$.

stage0027_04:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$ジン$$
（Heh... a show starring an unknown...

stage0027_04:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$ジン$$
（So he's the one $$ミカゲ$$ named, on par

stage0027_04:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$ジン$$

　than the rest, but why single him out...?）

stage0027_04:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$アルト$$

stage0027_04:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$アルト$$

stage0027_04:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$アルト$$
「A Vajra type I've never seen before!

stage0027_04:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$アルト$$

stage0027_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:

（You're coming along with me,
　until the day I find the ultimate melody）

stage0027_04:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$桂$$
「Man, getting swept up in a $$時空震動$$
　and landing right into a fight...
　And a headache on top of it all」

stage0027_04:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$モーム$$
「It'll be fine, Master $$桂$$!
　This $$モーム$$ is right here with you!」

stage0027_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$桂$$
「True enough.
　Small mercy we got hurled here
　while $$モーム$$ was riding in the $$オーガス$$」

stage0027_04:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$モーム$$
「So we're ready if this happens again,
　I'll ride in the $$オーガス$$ too!
　I can handle navigation, at least!」

stage0027_04:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$桂$$
「Got it, $$モーム$$.
　I'll be counting on you」

stage0027_04:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$モーム$$
「Leave it to me!
　For you, $$桂$$... $$モーム$$ will do her best!」

stage0027_04:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$桂$$
「Alright, let's go!
　Can't die before I get back to Mimsy's side!」
